notes: State expectations come from games/mirror-relic/tests/model.py (upstream rules 3.0.0), not from the emulator. Each hall is played with the breadth-first shortest solution from tests/model.py; synthetic-all-halls clears all six. X is the counterclockwise turn (sdk/keys_ext.inc, action 7). synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000 (channels F, D and C together). Walks leave 700000 cycles and turns 1500000 for the flight and relic sparkle.
